title: SpaceX has now lost the equivalent of a full Tesla in market capitalization
summary_full: Elon Musk's space company has wiped off more than $1.2 trillion in market cap since hitting a high of $225.64 per share in June.
summary_public: Elon Musk's space company has wiped off more than $1.2 trillion in market cap since hitting a high of $225.64 per share in June.
